pending.title: Birthday Party
pending.prompt: Create a birthday photo booth strip of four photos of the person in the photo at their party. Frame 1: smiling with a party hat. Frame 2: blowing out [NUMBER: 30] candles on a cake. Frame 3: laughing with confetti in the air. Frame 4: a silly pose with party glasses. Add a gold glitter backdrop, balloons and a strip footer with the date and "Happy Birthday". Use warm flash light, a little glitter in the air and the slightly grainy look of a real photo booth print, with a festive, joyful mood. Keep the person's face and identity unchanged in every frame.
